Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

Are you experienced in operating sawing machines and working with aluminium profiles? As a Saw Operator, you will cut aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and ensure that every piece meets the required quality standards.

You will work in a modern production environment in Roeselare, alternating between series production, one-off production and special pieces. You will work in a 2-shift system and use an ERP system to process production orders.

Your main tasks include:

 
• 
Reading technical drawings and determining how the pieces need to be cut.

 
• 
Setting up the sawing machine, including the required lengths and cutting angles.

 
• 
Cutting aluminium profiles for series production, one-off production and special pieces.

 
• 
Checking your own work using gauges and measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
Recording quality checks on inspection sheets.

 
• 
Processing production orders in the ERP system Business Central – Propos.

 
• 
Communicating relevant information during shift handovers.

 
• 
Carrying out first-line maintenance, such as cleaning the machine and replacing saw blades.

 
• 
Supporting other workstations when necessary.

 
• 
You have experience as a Operator.

 
• 
You can read technical drawings related to sawing and cutting components.

 
• 
You can work with measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
You can speak English. This is a requirement for the position.

 
• 
Basic knowledge of Dutch, both spoken and written, is an advantage.

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system suits you.

 
• 
You work accurately and check the quality of your own work.

 
• 
You keep your workplace clean and organised.

 
• 
Experience with an ERP system is an advantage.

We are looking for Motivated Packers of rice cookies!
We are urgently looking for people who can support our client in Zottegem. 

If you know how to tackle things, read on further! 

What are our expectations? 
• You are responsible for packing food products.
• You will keep basic records relating to your workstation.
• You will work in a 2-shift system (Monday to Friday, one week from 06h00 to 14h00 and the next week from 14h00 to 22h00).
• Fine work is not a problem for you.
• You work at a fast pace.
• You have a stable CV and positive references. 
• You are fluent in Dutch or English.

For our client, a niche player within the metal sector, we are looking for a welder on the night shift.

Duties:

- welding aluminum frames and structures using TIG welding.

- performing pre-assembly in preparation of welding work

- processing production orders via PC in the ERP system (Navision)

You have experience in tig welding, through work or training

You can work in the regular night shift

You speak, understand and read English well

You have an eye for quality, order and tidiness.

You are a team player with a positive attitude

You can work with a PC

Do you have experience in woodworking and take pride in delivering high-quality craftsmanship?

We are looking for a Production Worker Woodworking to help manufacture and assemble bespoke kitchens and custom-made furniture in a modern production environment.

Salary: starting at 17 euro bruto per hour   meal vouchers

• Producing and assembling custom kitchens and fixed furniture solutions.
• Working on high-end interior projects with great attention to detail and finishing quality.
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings and plans.
• Operating woodworking machinery and tools.
• Contributing to an efficient and smooth production process.

• You have completed a technical or vocational education in woodworking.
• You have previous experience as a woodworker, cabinet maker, or production worker in a similar role.
• You can read and interpret technical drawings.
• You possess strong technical skills and practical insight.
• You work in an organized and structured manner.
• You are flexible and able to perform well under pressure.
• You communicate fluently in English.
• You enjoy working as part of a team but can also work independently when required.

We are looking for an enthusiastic grinder for our production department.

Our client is an international player in modular systems for events, stand construction and so on.

Duties:

- grinding and deburring of aluminum profiles.

- alternating between serial work and piece work

- entering and processing orders in the computer

You have experience within the metal sector or have completed technical studies.

You can work with the computer

You have a good command of the English language

- performing pre-assembly in preparation of welding work

Scope
 

The project leader’s role is to technically manage IC design and supply projects to ensure technical quality and timely delivery. 
 

Responsibilities
 

Be the technical lead for an entire project, taking into account customer milestones and making sure technical specifications and quality standards are met:
 
 

• Daily follow-up of all project team members: designers, layouters, testers 

• Support and coach team members with technical expertise and strong problem solving skills 

• Maintain detailed overview and knowledge of the complete mixed-signal development 

• Organize, lead, attend internal status meetings to keep abreast about the project progress 

• Be the technical point of contact for the customer 

• Write the IC design specification and ensure a timely update in case of customer change requests 

• Ensure compliance with all safety and quality standards 

• Closely work together with and report potential problems on time to the Project Manager  
  
 

Competences
 
 

• You are a dynamic and highly motivated engineer in micro-electronics 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant industrial work experience 

• You are an experienced user of the mixed-signal flow of Cadence and/or Synopsys and Matlab 

• You have strong communication and reporting skills, also in English 

• You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem solving skills

Perhaps you found this vacancy thanks to our software? Because that’s what theMatchBox does: we build smart search engines that match the right job with the right candidate – or vice versa. By making clever use of a whole range of artificial intelligence tools – such as natural language processing, ontologies and large language models – we take into account spelling variations, typos, synonyms, context and everything else needed to compile, in a transparent manner, a list of matching jobs and candidates that is as accurate and comprehensive as possible.
 

theMatchBox is part of the Pixid Group and is a fast-growing HR tech scale-up with clients including staffing agencies, job sites and major employers both at home and abroad. Do you enjoy getting to grips with complex issues and would you like to play your part in improving the functioning of the labour market? Then come and join our team, as we could really do with your help.
 

Your tasks will be very varied. You’ll work on the API and the architecture of our matching software. In consultation with our account managers, you’ll integrate our software with the client’s systems so that all necessary data becomes searchable in our matching engine. Together with the client, you’ll determine which aspects of a job or candidate are important to them when making a match and configure our software accordingly. Finally, you’ll be part of our support team or resolve build issues… Everything is done in close collaboration and consultation with the team, and you’re always welcome to pop in and see us.

Your tasks will be very diverse. You will contribute to the API and the architecture of our matching software. In consultation with our account managers, you will integrate our software at the client's site so that all necessary data becomes searchable in our matching engine. Together with the client, you will determine which aspects of a job or candidate are important to them for a match and configure our software accordingly. Finally, you will work within our support system or fix build issues… Everything is done in close collaboration and consultation with the team, and you can always come to us with your ideas.
 

What do we expect from you? 
• You have a thorough knowledge of Java, 
• You have experience designing or maintaining a software architecture, 
• You enjoy navigating our complex software and algorithms, 
• You are interested in search engines and artificial intelligence, 
• When programming, you value accuracy, quality, and security, 
• You enjoy working independently (we will, of course, help you get started), 
• You can communicate clearly with clients and colleagues, 
• You can express yourself well in English.
 

What is not necessary but is nice to have? 
• Experience with Docker, Elasticsearch, 
• Experience deploying LLMs on GPUs, 
• Building software with Maven and Jenkins, 
• Managing servers with Ansible.

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.

• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.

• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.

• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.

• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.

• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.

• Fluent in English

As a Laser Operator, you will operate advanced laser cutting machines used to cut metal sheets and tubes to specification. You will monitor the quality of the production process and ensure operations run safely and efficiently.

Your responsibilities:

 
• Setting up and operating laser cutting machines.
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings.
 
• Performing quality checks on finished components.
 
• Identifying and resolving minor machine issues.
 
• Contributing to a safe and organized workplace.

 
• You have a technical education or a strong interest in technology.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

As a Press Brake Operator, you will be responsible for accurately bending metal parts based on technical drawings. You ensure that every component meets the required quality standards.

Your tasks:

 
• Setting up and operating CNC press brake machines.
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings.
 
• Checking the quality and dimensions of finished parts.
 
• Making minor adjustments where necessary.
 
• Maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

 
• You have a technical background or a strong technical affinity.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

Our client is a well-established and highly respected real estate agency with a strong presence in the market. Operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, the company is known for its commitment to excellence, client-centric approach, and entrepreneurial mindset. With an international outlook and a diverse portfolio of clients and projects, the agency offers a stimulating workplace where collaboration, professionalism, and innovation are valued. Joining this organization means becoming part of a successful team that thrives on challenge, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide comprehensive administrative and organizational support to the management team.
• Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and organize business travel arrangements.
• Prepare, review, and maintain correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents.
• Act as a key point of contact for clients, tenants, landlords, and external stakeholders, ensuring professional communication at all times.
• Support the coordination and follow-up of real estate transactions, property management activities, and client projects.
• Organize internal and external events, meetings, and client visits.
• Maintain and update databases, CRM systems, and property-related records, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent communication skills in English and French; additional languages are a strong asset.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a high level of professionalism.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with CRM or property management systems.

Our client is a renowned international law firm with offices in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

• Managing complex calendars, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments.
• Assisting with client onboarding and administrative file management.
• Supporting billing, expense processing, and timesheet administration.
• Organising travel arrangements and other logistical requirements.
• Drafting, formatting, editing, and finalising legal and business documents.
• Maintaining structured filing and document management systems.
• Acting as a first point of contact for clients and visitors, handling calls and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and visitor arrangements.
• Liaising with internal support teams to ensure efficient service delivery.
• Providing general administrative support.

• You have a minimum five years of experience in a Legal Secretary, Executive Assistant, or similar support role.
• You have strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• You have excellent communication skills in English, with a good command of French and/or Dutch.
• You are proficient in using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint).
• You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.
• You have strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
• You are known for being professional and discreet.

As a Bilingual Accountant in the public sector, you will manage financial operations AZ and ensure compliance with relevant regulations. This position offers a variety of responsibilities and benefits for a skilled professional in accounting and finance.

Client Details

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Description

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.
• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.
• Reconcile bank statements and monitor cash flow activities.
• Prepare and submit tax declarations and other regulatory filings.
• Provide financial insights and support decision-making processes.

A successful Bilingual Accountant should have:

• Proficiency in accounting principles and financial reporting.
• Strong knowledge of Winbooks.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Strong knowledge of public sector financial regulations.
• Residence in Brussels.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Experience at least 1 year in accounting.
• Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines efficiently.

Service Technician 
 

Are you someone who enjoys solving technical problems and helping customers? Do you like working independently while also contributing ideas for improvements and new technical projects? Then this opportunity could be the right fit for you.
 

For a company based in the 
Roeselare region, we are looking for a Service Technician who enjoys a varied role. You will work in a technical environment where maintenance, installations, troubleshooting, and project work go hand in hand.
 

Your Responsibilities
 
 

• Diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical failures at customer sites. 

• Perform preventive maintenance on a variety of technical installations. 

• Assist with the installation and commissioning of new systems. 

• Contribute to technical improvements and new projects. 

• Act as a point of contact for customers and provide technical advice when needed. 

• Ensure proper follow-up and after-sales support following completed work.  

You will work on a range of systems, including:
 
 

• Water treatment and irrigation installations such as pumps, valves, and PVC piping systems. 

• Mechanical and hydraulic installations. 

• Climate control and irrigation management systems. 

• Electrical installations, switchboards, cabling, and LED lighting systems.  

If you have an interest in design and engineering, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and optimization of electrical control panels.

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a degree in Electricity, Electromechanics, or a similar technical field. 

• You enjoy combining hands-on technical work with problem-solving and analytical thinking. 

• You are flexible and enjoy a diverse range of tasks. 

• You work accurately and take ownership of your responsibilities. 

• Experience as a service technician or in technical project work is an asset. 

• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 

• You possess a valid cat B driving license.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

If you’re ready to take on a fast-paced, varied role in a supportive and international environment, apply now and start your journey in customer service!

• Professional bachelor’s degree or higher secondary education

• Excellent spoken English, good German and Dutch language skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Strong verbal communication skills, analytical and problem-solving ability

• Customer-oriented, results-driven, accurate, and able to multitask under pressure

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• No specific work experience required; open to juniors and starters

• Able to work shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays

Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
